Qasam hai sitaare ki jab woh toota
Tumhaara saathi na gumraah hua hai aur na behka
Aur woh apni khwaahish se kalaam bhi nahin karta hai
Us ka kalaam wahi wahi hai jo musalsal naazil hoti rehti hai
Use nihaayat taaqat waale ne ta'leem di hai
Woh saahib-e-husn o jamaal jo seedha khada hua
Jab ke woh buland-tareen ufuq par tha
Phir woh qareeb hua aur aage badha
Yahaan tak ke do kamaan ya us se kam ka faasla reh gaya
Phir Khuda ne apne bande ki taraf jis raaz ki baat chaahi wahi kar di
Dil ne us baat ko jhutlaaya nahin jis ko aankhon ne dekha
Kya tum us se us baat ke baare mein jhagda kar rahe ho jo woh dekh raha hai
Aur us ne to use ek baar aur bhi dekha hai
Sidrat-ul-Muntaha ke nazdeek
Jis ke paas Jannat-ul-Maawa bhi hai
Jab Sidra par chha raha tha jo kuch ke chha raha tha
Us waqt us ki aankh na behki aur na hadd se aage badhi
Us ne apne Parwardigar ki badi badi nishaaniyaan dekhi hain
Kya tum logon ne Laat aur Uzza ko dekha hai
Aur Manaat jo un ka teesra hai use bhi dekha hai
To kya tumhaare liye ladke hain aur us ke liye ladkiyaan hain
Yeh intehaai na-insaafi ki taqseem hai

Yeh sab woh naam hain jo tum ne aur tumhaare baap daada ne tai kar liye hain, Khuda ne un ke baare mein koi daleel naazil nahin ki hai. Dar-haqeeqat yeh log sirf apne gumaanon ka ittibaa' kar rahe hain aur jo kuch un ka dil chaahta hai, aur yaqeenan un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se un ke paas hidaayat aa chuki hai
Kya insaan ko woh sab mil sakta hai jis ki aarzoo kare
Bas Allah hi ke liye duniya aur aakhirat sab kuch hai
Aur aasmaanon mein kitne hi farishte hain jin ki sifaarish kisi ke kaam nahin aa sakti hai jab tak Khuda, jis ke baare mein chaahe aur use pasand kare, ijaazat na de de
Beshak jo log aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte hain woh malaaika ke naam ladkiyon jaise rakhte hain
Haalaanke un ke paas is silsile mein koi ilm nahin hai. Yeh sirf wahm o gumaan ke peechhe chale ja rahe hain, aur gumaan haq ke baare mein koi faaida nahin pahuncha sakta hai
Lihaaza jo shakhs bhi hamaare zikr se munh phere aur zindagaani-e-duniya ke ilaawa kuch na chaahe aap bhi us se kinaara-kash ho jaayein
Yahi un ke ilm ki intiha hai, aur beshak aap ka Parwardigar khoob jaanta hai ke kaun us ke raaste se behak gaya hai aur kaun hidaayat ke raaste par hai
Aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ke kul ikhtiyaaraat hain, taake woh bad-amal afraad ko un ke aamaal ki saza de sake aur nek amal karne waalon ko un ke aamaal ka achchha badla de sake

Jo log gunaahaan-e-kabeera aur fahsh baaton se parhez karte hain (gunaahaan-e-sagheera ke ilaawa), beshak aap ka Parwardigar un ke liye bahut wasee' maghfirat waala hai. Woh us waqt bhi tum sab ke haalaat se khoob waaqif tha jab us ne tumhein khaak se paida kiya tha, aur us waqt bhi jab tum maa ke shikam mein janeen ki manzil mein the. Lihaaza apne nafs ko zyaada paakeeza qaraar na do, woh muttaqi afraad ko khoob pehchaanta hai
Kya aap ne use bhi dekha hai jis ne munh pher liya
Aur thoda sa raah-e-Khuda mein de kar band kar diya
Kya us ke paas ilm-e-ghaib hai jis ke zariye woh dekh raha hai
Ya use us baat ki khabar hi nahin hai jo Moosa alaihis-salaam ke saheefon mein thi
Ya Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ke saheefon mein thi jinhon ne poora poora haq ada kiya hai
Koi shakhs bhi doosre ka bojh uthaane waala nahin hai
Aur insaan ke liye sirf utna hi hai jitni us ne koshish ki hai
Aur us ki koshish anqareeb us ke saamne pesh kar di jaaegi
Us ke baad use poora badla diya jaaega
Aur beshak sab ki aakhri manzil Parwardigar ki baargaah hai
Aur yeh ke usi ne hansaaya bhi hai aur rulaaya bhi hai
Aur wahi maut o hayaat ka dene waala hai
Aur usi ne nar aur maada ka joda paida kiya hai
Us nutfe se jo rahm mein daala jaata hai
Aur usi ke zimme doosri zindagi bhi hai
Aur usi ne maaldaar banaaya hai aur sarmaaya ata kiya hai
Aur wahi sitaara-e-Shi'ra ka maalik hai
Aur usi ne pehle qaum-e-Aad ko halaak kiya hai
Aur qaum-e-Samood ko bhi, phir kisi ko baaqi nahin chhoda hai
Aur qaum-e-Nooh ko un se pehle, ke woh log bade zaalim aur sarkash the
Aur usi ne qaum-e-Loot ki ulti bastiyon ko patak diya hai
Phir un ko dhaank liya jis cheez ne ke dhaank liya
Ab tum apne Parwardigar ki kis ne'mat par shak kar rahe ho
Beshak yeh Paighambar bhi agle daraane waalon mein se ek daraane waala hai
Dekho qiyaamat qareeb aa gayi hai
Allah ke ilaawa koi us ka taalne waala nahin hai
Kya tum is baat se ta'ajjub kar rahe ho
Aur phir hanste ho aur rote nahin ho
Aur tum bilkul ghaafil ho
(Ab bhi ghaneemat hai) ke Allah ke liye sajda karo aur us ki ibaadat karo
